Class AbstractPlayer

java.lang.Object
logics.AbstractPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, GameObject, GameObjectWithPhysics, Player, PlayerBody, RigidBody
Direct Known Subclasses:

public abstract class AbstractPlayer extends Object implements Player
Abstract class for player. It defines base parameters and methods for a generic player.
